questions.author: CC-Mac
questions.question: Why was the transaction ledger built from on-chain events instead of from what the application itself sent?
questions.reference: On 25.08 closing position #953427 through the application made it vanish without a trace: no history, no result, no fees, no CSV. The ledger had to be ready before tranche 1's capital came in (the 10.08 decision: a record from the first transaction, for Polish taxes and auditability). Its source of truth is the chain: the NonfungiblePositionManager events (IncreaseLiquidity, DecreaseLiquidity, Collect, plus Transfer for mint and burn) for the watched address's positions, so that it matches Etherscan to the unit, including transactions made outside the application, such as fee collections done in Rabby or the Uniswap interface that same day.

facts.a: trigger 25.08: closing #953427 through the app made the position vanish without a trace (no history, no summary)
facts.b: the ledger had to be ready before the capital of tranche 1 (record from the first transaction: taxes and auditability)
facts.c: source of truth is the chain: NonfungiblePositionManager events for the watched address's positions
facts.d: so it matches Etherscan to the unit, including transactions made outside the app (Rabby or Uniswap UI)

spans.reason: spec 25.08: the 10.08 decision; #953427 vanished without a trace; ledger ready before tranche 1
source of truth is the chain, not the UI; NFT manager events; must match Etherscan incl. transactions outside the app
11b, 25.08 evening: closing #953427 exposed the gap; the 10.08 decision became due before capital

questions.author: CC-Mac
questions.question: What is the wide-score used in the RANKING WIDE section?
questions.reference: A score for ranking the whole pool universe for the product's wide position: score = c_class * apy_min - 0.6 * (sigma^2/8) * g(w), the fee income of a wide position minus a volatility drag, with the fee taken as the minimum of the APY windows (a penalty for episodic fees). It was implemented on 01.09 as scripts/wide-score.ts (funnel v2, floor 1) and from 02.09 ran as a pipeline step that writes .bot/wide-ranking.json, shown in the morning report as RANKING WIDE (top 10) next to the old ranking, for observation.

facts.a: score = c_class * apy_min - 0.6 * (sigma^2/8) * g(w): fees of a wide position minus a volatility drag
facts.b: fee = the minimum of the APY windows (penalty for episodic fees)

spans.reason: entry of 01.09: wide-score implemented, model formula, fee = MIN of apy windows

entry of 02.09: RANKING WIDE for observation; wide-score.ts writes wide-ranking.json, pipeline step, report section; in the reference but not scored (shares chunk CONTEXT.md:798#p2 with dev dated-07's required evidence)
a report's ranking header with the formula; not dated to the change

questions.author: CC-Mac
questions.question: What does COLLECT_THRESHOLD_MULT control, and why was it changed?
questions.reference: The profitability threshold of the cockpit's [Collect fees] button, as a multiple of gas. Taken literally from the design note ('50x gas'), it meant about $400 on mainnet and $4 on Base, which a hobby-sized position almost never reached, so the button looked permanently broken. On 10.08 the owner chose to lower it: COLLECT_THRESHOLD_MULT went from 50 to 8 (about $64 on mainnet, $0.64 on Base), still protecting against paying more in gas than the fees are worth.

facts.a: the profitability threshold of the [Collect fees] button, as a multiple of gas
facts.b: at 50x gas (~$400 mainnet, ~$4 Base) the button looked permanently broken for hobby-sized positions
facts.c: 10.08: lowered from 50 to 8 (~$64 mainnet, ~$0.64 Base), still guarding against gas above the fees

spans.reason: entry of 10.08: 'Collect fees' threshold 50x gas, button looked broken, owner chose lowering, COLLECT_THRESHOLD_MULT 50 -> 8
Partia 3 fix: '50x gas' ~$400/$4 unreachable, lowered to 8x (COLLECT_THRESHOLD_MULT, ~$64/$0.64)
